info.name: server-moderation-session-service
info.description: server-moderation-session-service (Team 19, Topic 3 — Student ID, Please): shifts, the applicant queue, live updates (SSE) and the error contract, as of Lab 5 (`decision.recorded` arrives from the Message Broker; the REST stand-in is local only, see the queue folder; closing a shift is a two-phase commit with `player-service`, coordinated by the Message Broker, so every closed shift's moderators must be registered players: the first request of Happy Path registers one, and the two-phase folders show the commit and the abort). Run the folders top to bottom, or use the Collection Runner: later requests use {{sessionId}} and the applicant captured on the way. Calls go through the API Gateway (`baseUrl` http://localhost:8080) with the API key from the `apiKey` variable as `Authorization: Bearer` (one of the keys in GATEWAY_API_KEYS; never stored here). Every request sends its own `X-Request-Id` and checks that it comes back, and every error is checked for the `{error, message}` shape. The live stream is sent by hand (`watchLive`); instance status, metrics and the two-phase participant routes need `sessionInstanceUrl` (see those folders). `Get Session By Id` keeps a saved example of `503 DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE`, the answer while the replicated database fails over (Lab 5); it is never run.

item.name: Two-Phase Commit Close (Lab 5)
item.description: Lab 5, Grade 8: with `SHIFT_CLOSE_MODE=two-phase` (the CPR compose default), `POST /sessions/{id}/close` closes the shift in this service's database and credits it to the moderators in `player-service`'s, as one transaction coordinated by the Message Broker (CPR `contracts/two-phase.md`). Committed: `200` and the shift counted in the moderator's stats at once. A participant votes NO (here: a junior moderator who isn't a registered player): `409 SHIFT_CLOSE_ABORTED`, nothing changed in either database. Uses `player-service` through the Gateway too.

request.description: `player-service` (through the Gateway): closing a shift is a two-phase commit with `player-service` (Lab 5), which votes NO for a moderator who isn't a registered player.

Two-Phase Commit Participant (direct, local only)
item.description: Lab 5, Grade 8: this service is also a participant of the shift's two-phase commit. The broker calls `POST /internal/two-phase/{transactionId}/prepare | commit | abort` over gRPC; on HTTP they are reachable only on the Compose network, and the Gateway routes no `/internal` path. These requests play the coordinator by hand: the shift is closed under a prepared transaction, visible only after the commit. Set `sessionInstanceUrl` (e.g. `http://server-moderation-session-service:8082` for newman on the Compose network); empty, the whole folder is skipped.
